what_happened: The job to raise per-agent budget and timeout caps in athena.toml was rejected. The request said only athena.toml should change. The verifier found 1 of 5 acceptance criteria unmet: the criterion that only athena.toml changes and config.rs and other files stay untouched. It also reported two major findings. First, six files outside the allowed set were changed (config.rs, admission.rs, reading.rs, run/tests.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, cli/tests/drain.rs). Second, the reading did not match the request, so the criteria that passed did not show the request was met. No failed checks are listed. The job probably edited code and tests to make the raised caps work, probably because of the job-budget and admission rules and the pinned tests that read the same config.
cause: The "only athena.toml changes" limit exists only as prose that the verifier reads at the end. The producer has no machine-checked list of allowed paths, so it can edit code and tests while chasing the outcome, and nothing stops or flags that during the run. Config edits to caps also ripple into admission checks (job budget against the sum of stage caps) and tests that pin config values. The reading did not name these dependencies or say what to do when they bite. The producer therefore fixed them in code instead of stopping and reporting. A reading that misstated the request also let the criteria pass without proving the request was met.
prevention: Add a code check that compares the job's diff file list against the allowed deliverables from the accepted reading. It should run before the verifier, and also whenever the producer finishes. For a config-only job, any file outside the allowed set should fail the check right away, and the producer should be told to stop and report the blocker (such as an admission refusal or a pinned test) instead of editing code. The reading should also list the config-dependent checks (job budget against the sum of stage caps, pinned tests) so the job raises the job budget in the same athena.toml edit.
proposed_request: Raise the per-agent budget and timeout caps in athena.toml for the roles that have repeatedly stopped at their caps. In the same edit, raise the job-level budget so it covers the sum of the stage caps, so admission accepts the config. Change only athena.toml, plus a CHANGELOG.md entry if the changelog default requires one. Do not change anything under crates/, including config.rs, admission.rs, reading.rs and any tests. If a test or admission rule refuses the new values, stop and report which one and why, and do not edit code to get around it. Acceptance: (1) the git diff file list contains only athena.toml, plus CHANGELOG.md if required; (2) each raised cap is named with its old and new value in the changelog or the job report; (3) the job budget is at least the sum of the stage caps; (4) the existing test suite and the admission check pass unchanged.
